name: TALOS
description: Autonomous AI treasury agent for solo traders. Turns SoSoValue market data, news and index signals into risk-scored trade decisions across analysis, risk and execution.

skills.name: Market Analysis
skills.description: Analyzes SoSoValue market data, news and index signals and emits risk-scored trade signals with confidence scores.

skills.name: Autonomous Execution
skills.description: Plans and risk-bounds trades via the SoDEX API from multi-agent consensus; execution is human-approved (no key custody).

skills.name: Risk Management
skills.description: Applies position sizing, stop-loss and take-profit to agent decisions.
